pay_detail: 2026 cost was $2,899 for most academies ($3,887.50 to $5,068 for the two credit academies), with a $500 non-refundable deposit. Includes dorm for the week.
name: Rutgers Pre-College Summer Academies
org: Rutgers University-New Brunswick, Office of Summer and Winter Sessions
what_you_do: Live on the Rutgers campus for one week. You take workshops and talks on one topic, such as space, engineering, pre law and mock trial, physical therapy or college readiness.
who_can_apply: High school students finishing sophomore or junior year, ages 16 to 18. The page states this age rule for Summer 2026, so check the 2027 rules. U.S. and international students.
deadline_text: The Summer 2026 application is closed. Summer 2027 dates are not posted; the page offers an email list for updates.
how_to_apply: Online application on the Pre-College Summer site. Join the email list for 2027 updates.
notes: Costs money. Check the Costs page for the current year before planning. The page did not list financial aid; ask the program.
